items.label: Daily Drawdown
items.detail: Equity must not fall below 3.5% of previous day's closing balance at any point. Resets daily at 17:00 NY Time. Hard breach = immediate closure without refund.

items.label: Max Overall Drawdown
items.detail: Equity must not fall below 7% of initial balance. Static for account lifetime. Hard breach = immediate closure without refund.

items.label: Floating DD — Warning
items.detail: Warning notification issued when combined unrealised loss on any single symbol reaches 1.0% of initial balance. No strike applied. Example: $50K account → warning at −$500 on any one symbol.

items.label: Floating DD — Breach
items.detail: First breach = formal warning, no strike. Second breach onwards = 1 soft breach strike each time. Measured per symbol, net of all open positions on that symbol. Always vs initial balance (not current equity).

items.label: Profit Target
items.detail: Instant funding — no evaluation, no profit target required.

items.label: Min Profitable Days
items.detail: No minimum profitable days required on Standard accounts.

items.label: Consistency Rule
items.detail: No consistency requirement for this account type.

items.label: Weekend Hold
items.detail: Weekend holding only permitted via Weekend Holding Add-On. Without it, all positions must be flat before 17:00 NY Time Friday. Any position remaining open = soft breach strike.

items.label: Strike Sources
items.detail: Strikes are cumulative across all rules: Notional Volume + Weekend Hold + Floating DD. Example: 1 strike from each = 3 total strikes on the account.

items.label: Per Strike
items.detail: Each cumulative strike reduces the next payout cycle by 10%.

items.label: 5th Strike
items.detail: 5 total cumulative strikes = permanent account closure.

items.label: Hard Breach
items.detail: Daily or max drawdown violation = instant permanent termination. No recovery, no refund.

items.label: Profit Split
items.detail: Starting split for all Standard funded accounts.

items.label: Payout Cycle
items.detail: First payout on-demand after first profitable trade. Subsequent payouts every 7 days.

items.label: Min Days
items.detail: No minimum profitable days required before requesting a payout.
